sentences.text:
on 18 September, 2023 18.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 3631 of 2023  SL. 8 Court No. 29  Sourav  In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of (Dismissed) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Berhampore  Police Station Case No. 620 of 2020 dated 29.06.2020 under Sections 376/370/372/373/34 IPC read with Sections  3/4/5/7 of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act with Sections  4/8/12/17 of the POCSO Act.
 And  In the matter of: Sunhakar Chakraborty @ Subhankar  Chakraborty  ....petitioner.
 Mr. Arnab Chatterjee  Mr. Anisur Rahaman  ...for the petitioner.
 Mr. Sudip Ghosh  Mr. Koushik Kundu  ...for the State.
 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2.

been published under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. against the petitioner on 29.12.2021 and the present petition for anticipatory bail having been filed on 16.08.2023, it is not maintainable as such, in view of authoritative judicial dictums.
3. Accordingly, the application being CRM (A) 3631 of 2023 is dismissed.
4. The report dated 14.09.2023 as submitted by I.C. Berhampore P.S., Murshidabad be taken on record.

5. However, if the petitioner appears before the competent Court within 15 days from today with three days advance notice to the PP/APP attached to the said Court and files application for bail,
such application for bail shall be disposed of on merit on the same day.
It is also mentioned that in the event the ground of parity is canvassed by the present petitioner, the same may be considered liberally by the said competent court in accordance with law.
